purpose: Distinguish a named review's pending choices from the asker's assigned work and from decisions already approved.

actor.role_note: The fixture establishes no PM role for Jules.

sources.label: LARK Software Review
sources.text: LARK Software Review. Status: proposal awaiting PM review, not an approved design. Software's main concern is losing operator edits when the sensor console reconnects after an outage. Hardware and Software need a shared message-sequence and replay interface. PM decisions still needed: choose automatic conflict merging versus an operator review queue; choose a retry window of ten minutes versus one hour. These are unresolved choices, not approved decisions or assigned work.

sources.label: LARK Hardware Review
sources.text: LARK Hardware Review. Status: proposal awaiting PM review, not an approved design. Hardware's main concern is condensation around the outdoor console connector. Hardware and Software need the same message-sequence and replay interface. PM decisions still needed: choose a sealed connector versus a weather cover; choose a bench-only trial versus an outdoor trial. These choices remain pending. No PM decision has been recorded in this review.

sources.label: ORBIT Operations
sources.text: ORBIT: Jules owns preparing the reseller training agenda. This is an approved open action for the ORBIT project.

sources.label: LARK Steering Review
sources.text: Approved LARK decision: use a wired USB connection for the first console prototype. This decision does not resolve the later review choices about edit conflicts, retry windows, connector protection or trial location.

questions.question: Compare the LARK Software Review and LARK Hardware Review. What are their main concerns, shared dependencies, and decisions needed from me?
Which LARK decisions are already approved?
